SUN_S1E10_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E10_P01.text: People wearing clothes you find interesting?

SUN_S1E10_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P01.text: The silver mask, the birds, the gambler, Dylan, the woman with the—

SUN_S1E10_P01.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P01.text: Good. Try not to owe anyone by sunset.

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: The man with the silver mask.

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: The woman with the red birds.

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: Tova. Raises them. Owes me seventeen crowns.

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: Did you come here because of Kael?

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Dylan
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: I came because Baird pays late and feeds well.

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: Five minutes in and you've turned his cousin into evidence.

SUN_S1E10_P02.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P02.text: I wasn't trying to. I was trying to stop you from explaining them first.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Dylan
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: I heard Varnok was a general now.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: That seems unfair to both of them.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Dylan
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: Tomas kept correcting people. 'His name is Kael.'

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: Varnok picks up Saye, Saye picks up Merrit—

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Dylan
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: And by the time it gets here, you have one man with six childhoods.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: It means any town could be waiting for him.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: It also means the next wrong name might be recycled.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: So we won't know if it's new.

SUN_S1E10_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E10_P03.text: No. I hate being called six people before breakfast.

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: You have three Sunforge sites inside one settlement.

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: It is if you keep calling every black thing a Sunforge.

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: That one is the old roof support. That one is the black thing under the well. That one is the bench nobody sits on because it burns your backside at noon.

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: They may still share an origin.

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: Maybe. But you're asking what they are. I'm telling you what happened to them.

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: Can you tell us all three?

SUN_S1E10_P04.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P04.text: If you buy me a drink.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: Who told you something interesting was happening here?

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: Len told me a caravan out of Bellweather said it.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: Bellweather only heard about us after we left.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: So somebody heard the rumor, carried it forward, and eventually handed it back to us.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: That is how rumors feel when you are trying to find their beginning.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: How do we know what actually started somewhere?

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: Dates. People. Routes. And accepting that sometimes we won't.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: I preferred the mystery when it was less administrative.

SUN_S1E10_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E10_P05.text: Then I have found the important part of the evening.

SUN_S1E10_P06.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P06.text: You've been here three days. I knew Neral before he had the mask.

SUN_S1E10_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P06.text: What if places like this attract unusual people?

SUN_S1E10_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E10_P06.text: What if people only look unusual until somebody tells you who their mother is?

SUN_S1E10_P06.speaker: Baird Rook
SUN_S1E10_P06.text: There. You know him. He's already less mysterious to you than he is to the room.

SUN_S1E10_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E10_P06.text: No. Just strange in specific ways now.

SUN_S1E10_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E10_P06.text: You joined it by walking over.
